Former Cricketer Praveen Kumar Applies for BCCI Junior Selection Committee Role

Former Indian cricketer Praveen Kumar has applied for a position on the BCCI Junior Selection Committee. Kumar stated that he wishes to contribute to cricket. He is reportedly facing competition from two other players for the role.
